dispositions.meaning: Retain a bounded relational orientation definition while isolating the stronger constitutive claim for independent testing.
Separate attentional access and weighting from experienced affordance.
Require incremental prediction from identity centrality beyond incentives, threat and coalition pressure before retention.
Meaning does not entail warrant, while meaningful coherence may remain defeasible evidence.
Separate descriptive correction capacity from the normative proposal of bounded corrigibility.
Separate recurrence detection from explanatory model comparison.
Treat proposed moral invariants as diagnostic questions rather than established invariants.
Hold comparative metaphysical interpretation until empirical and normative dependencies mature.
